correctness.rationale: The identification of rook vertices with K_{m,n} edges converts each length-two geodesic triple into exactly a selected 3-edge bipartite path. Connected bipartite P4-free graphs are exactly stars. The labeled exponential formula counts their disconnected components with isolated edge separately. The three exclusive maximality cases are proved by adding missing edges. Inclusion-exclusion and restricted set partitions enumerate these cases; a constructive c-component family gives every asserted maximal-set size. A separate direct shortest-path BFS program checked 370512 subsets on ten boards; 42 further symbolic board identities agree. No finite search is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: For the natural class of two-factor rook graphs, the complete distribution of all general-position sets and all inclusion-maximal sets is a substantially finer invariant than the known minimum and maximum sizes. The bipartite star-forest equivalence resolves both polynomials in a uniform two-parameter expression and proves an arbitrarily long interval of absent maximal-set sizes, a structural gap phenomenon with direct consequences for general-position enumeration. Exact all-cardinality coefficients and constructive support witness provide reusable enumerative information beyond a small numerical improvement.
